name: ⛸️ Run a Figure Skating Club!
desc:
୨୧ ♡ ⛸️ Run a Figure Skating Club!  ♡ ୨୧

JOIN THE GROUP!
https://www.roblox.com/communities/312465046/Lumaire-Studios#!/about

୭ ˚. Build your dream figure skating club!  ❄️

💎 Collect skaters from Common to Mythic and Secret!

👗 Dress up your skaters in beautiful boutique outfits!

🎶 Create routines for solos, pairs, and synchro teams!

🏆 Compete with other players or challenge your friends!

💰 Earn cash, unlock outfits, and get more spins!

♡ Discover rare skaters, design beautiful routines, and turn your little club into a skating dream! ❄️

୨୧ ♡ your club, your skaters, your story ♡ ୨୧

unique: figure skating routine builder with dress-up and collection
